summary: quad bike: a tube frame with plastic fenders, four wheels on arms and an axle, rider on a saddle with handlebars.

rear.summary: rear fenders, rack, tail lamp, axle

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Tube frame
items.construction: tubes swept between joints (mesh.sweep with a round profile): rails, cradle, footrest mounts

items.name: Fenders and body
items.construction: front and rear fenders and the tank cover lofted as one welded soft body that sits on the frame

items.name: Wheel (cloned to the four dummies)
items.construction: kit.wheel or mesh.lathe balloon tyre with a deep tread band, a rim and a hub

items.name: Front A-arms and shocks
items.construction: upper and lower arms with a shock to each front hub (frames suspension_lf / suspension_rf)

items.name: Rear axle
items.construction: axle tube with hubs and a sprocket

items.name: Handlebars
items.construction: bar on a stem with grips and levers; the steering axis runs through the stem

items.name: Seat
items.construction: long soft saddle lofted on the body

items.name: Engine
items.construction: block with cylinder, cases and covers between the feet

items.name: Exhaust
items.construction: pipe swept from the cylinder to a muffler at the rear

items.name: Footrests
items.construction: plates or pegs on each side of the frame

items.name: Headlamps
items.construction: lenses set into the front fender or the bar pod

items.name: Tail lamp
items.construction: lens set into the rear fender

items.name: Front and rear racks
items.construction: tube racks swept over the fenders

items.name: Fender inner faces
items.construction: inner faces of the fenders over the tyres: never see-through

items.name: Rear shock
items.construction: coil-over from the frame to the axle carrier

items.name: Instruments
items.construction: small gauge pod on the bars

items.name: Number plate
items.construction: plate card on a bracket at the rear

items.name: Chain and sprockets
items.construction: chain band from the engine sprocket to the axle sprocket with a guard

items.name: Brake discs and calipers
items.construction: lathe discs behind the rims

items.name: Cables and hoses
items.construction: brake lines and throttle cables swept from the bars down to the frame

items.name: Radiator
items.construction: small radiator with a grille in front of the engine

items.name: Grab handles
items.construction: tube handles beside the seat
